paraphrase: Tilak argues that the Gītā's principal teaching is karma-yoga: the one who has realized Brahman should go on acting for the welfare of the world (lokasaṃgraha) without attachment, rather than renounce action; knowledge and devotion support such action.

queries: Gita Rahasya Tilak karma yoga thesis
checks.note: The book (also called Karmayoga Śāstra) argues that the Gītā teaches karma-yoga, action by the one who knows, rather than renunciation; the thesis is confirmed at the level of a whole-work summary.
